title: FolioCharge (canonical entity)
description: Canonical folio charge emitted by every connector. business_date is the property-local business date the charge posts to (late postings across midnight count to the prior business date). Money is an exact decimal string with 2 fraction digits (never float).

charge_id.description: Canonical key shared by the connector, runtime and verifier.

property_id.description: Owning property; selects the property-local business-date calendar.

business_date.description: Property-local business date the charge posts to.

amount.description: Exact decimal string with 2 fraction digits; Decimal end to end, never float. Negative values are refunds/adjustments.

description.description: Nullable demo field; vendors may omit or null it.

posted_at.description: Source timestamp of posting; an aware UTC instant, never a naive business date.
